name: hero-A-golden-drift
prompt: Interior photograph of a boutique dental practice waiting room, shot wide. Warm honey-toned wood-plank flooring, a textured off-white stone accent wall, two burnt-orange cognac leather armchairs with slim black metal frames, a long tufted taupe bench along the left wall beneath a window with white venetian blinds, a potted palm in a white ceramic planter. Vaulted white ceiling with small black track spotlights and recessed cans. Late afternoon sunlight rakes through the blinds casting long soft stripes across the wood floor, faint dust motes in the light. Calm, warm, residential rather than clinical, no people, no signage or text anywhere. Shot on a 24mm lens at f4, natural light, subtle film grain. Wide landscape composition.

name: hero-B-paper-craft
prompt: A layered cut-paper diorama of a warm boutique dental waiting room, viewed straight on. Built from six visible depth layers of matte construction paper: honey-tan wood-plank floor, an off-white textured back wall, two burnt-orange paper armchairs with thin black paper frames, a long taupe paper bench, a green paper palm in a white paper pot, and a paper window with cut paper light rays falling across the floor. Visible scissor-cut edges and real paper thickness, soft drop shadows between every layer, matte paper fibre texture. Even soft studio lighting. No text, no lettering. Wide landscape composition.

name: hero-C-miniature
prompt: A highly detailed architectural scale model of a boutique dental waiting room, photographed as a tabletop miniature with tilt-shift shallow focus. Honey wood-plank floor, off-white textured stone wall, two tiny burnt-orange leather armchairs with black metal frames, a small tufted taupe bench, a miniature palm in a white pot, a little window with working blinds throwing light stripes across the floor. Vaulted ceiling with minute track lights actually glowing. Visible model-making craft in the materials, slightly soft paint edges. Macro lens at f4, warm soft studio lighting, deep grey background falling off behind. No people, no text or signage. Wide landscape composition.
